properties.nameThOfficialAlt: เขตที่ ๑ (เขตเลือกตั้ง)
properties.method: APPROXIMATE DEMONSTRATION PARTITION — not the official legal zone boundaries. Basis: the municipality's map 'แผนที่ชุมชนภายในเขตเทศบาลนครหาดใหญ่ จำนวน 103 ชุมชน' (PDF on hatyaicity.go.th/content/cate/259, revised 14 พ.ย. 2565) draws the limits of เขต 1-4 as thick lines along (a) the main southern railway line, (b) ถนนเพชรเกษม, and in the south-east (c) ถนนศรีภูวนารถ and (d) ถนนกาญจนวณิชย์; the community boundary announcements confirm these lines (e.g. ชุมชนบ้านพักรถไฟ, เขต 2: N ถนนเพชรเกษม, S ถนนศรีภูวนารถ, W แนวเขตรถไฟ; ชุมชนขนส่ง, เขต 3: E แนวถนนกาญจนวนิชย์). Deterministic construction: OSM ways (railway=rail without service tag; highway named ถนนเพชรเกษม [secondary], ถนนศรีภูวนารถ, ถนนกาญจนวณิชย์) are chained by shortest path over shared OSM nodes (gaps <= 120 m between way end nodes, e.g. unnamed roundabouts, are bridged by straight segments) (railway: northernmost node -> southernmost node of the Padang Besar line; ถนนเพชรเกษม: westernmost node connected to its junction with ถนนกาญจนวณิชย์ -> that junction; ถนนศรีภูวนารถ: westernmost node -> easternmost connected node, joined to the nearest ถนนกาญจนวณิชย์ node, then ถนนกาญจนวณิชย์ to its southernmost connected node), each path is closed into a half-plane polygon with a frame, and the OSM municipality polygon M is split: เขต4 = M∩N∩W, เขต1 = (M∩N)−W, เขต3 = (M−N)∩(W∪Q), เขต2 = (M−N)−(W∪Q), where N = north of ถนนเพชรเกษม, W = west of the railway main line, Q = south of ถนนศรีภูวนารถ and west of ถนนกาญจนวณิชย์. Parts < 20,000 m² that are not a zone's largest part are merged into the neighbouring zone with the largest shared 3 m halo. The tiling of M is verified in hatyai-ingest-report.json (checks.zones.tiling / tilingWritten): no overlaps, and gaps/outside areas only at coordinate-rounding level (a few m² in total out of ~20.9 km²). Validation only (not used to build the zones): named OSM landmarks whose zone can be read from the official 103-community map are tested against the partition (checks.zoneLandmarkValidation).
properties.anchorMethod: interior label point: rounded centroid if inside and >= 150 m from the zone edge, else the farthest-from-edge point of a 60x60 grid over the zone bbox
